# logfire_gateway_spending_limits (Resource)

Manages the AI Gateway spending limits of the organization. An organization limit caps the Gateway spend of every project and credential in the organization. Requires a plan that includes the AI Gateway and a token with `organization:read_gateway` and `organization:write_gateway` scopes (`organization:read` and `organization:write` are also accepted).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap the Gateway spend of the whole organization. A window you omit has no limit.
resource "logfire_gateway_spending_limits" "this" {
  daily_usd   = 500
  monthly_usd = 10000
}
```

## Ownership

The resource owns all three windows. A window you omit has no limit, and
destroying the resource removes every organization limit.

Creating the resource replaces any limits set in the Logfire UI. To keep them,
import the resource first and copy the imported values into your configuration.

Declare at most one of this resource for each organization. The resource manages
the organization of the provider's credentials and stores no organization ID. If
the provider switches to another organization's credentials, the next plan reads
and manages that organization's limits.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `daily_usd` (Number) The daily limit in whole US dollars. A day starts at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no daily limit.
- `monthly_usd` (Number) The monthly limit in whole US dollars. A month starts on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no monthly limit.
- `weekly_usd` (Number) The weekly limit in whole US dollars. A week starts on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no weekly limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `organization`.

## Import

The organization has one set of spending limits, so the import ID is always
`organization`:

```terraform
import {
  to = logfire_gateway_spending_limits.this
  id = "organization"
}
```

Or use the command line:

```shell
# The organization has one set of spending limits, so the import ID is always "organization".
terraform import 'logfire_gateway_spending_limits.this' "organization"
```
